t: r/Tools on Reddit: Quality of life upgrade, rubber bristle broom. Doesn't fling chips, wood or metal, everywhere while you sweep. Tip from NYCCNC.
s: January 9, 2022 - The bristle material (rubber, plastic, natural fibers, etc.) matters for several reasons. One of the more important advantages of rubber material is the static charge created when friction is applied. The result is that the motion of sweeping creates a static force that attracts dust, hair, and lighter weight dirt so less junk is left behind. To enhance this static-cling effect, I’ve seen some rubber broom companies with instructions to use quick, short sweeping motions in order to maximize the static charge generated and attract larger items or heavier dirt.
